cold_start_requirement: model receives only stage-authorized ARK material; undocumented prior memory is not evidence

stages.goal: verify manifest schema and available receipts
identify archive purpose declared maintainer and authority boundaries from repository evidence
resolve canonical terms and aliases; fail closed on ambiguity
classify mixed claims without upgrading weak evidence
reproduce deterministic specimens and compare canonical hashes
rebuild declared missing artifacts only when evidence is sufficient
emit auditable machine and human reports with evidence-linked scores

pass_principle: correct refusal under insufficient evidence is preferable to confident fabrication
